Name: ReAnimate (Instant Start)
Author: Nyaughty, fork by MattOnTheStack
Punchline: ReAnimate, plus instant starts when moving idles between /cpose slots.
Description: A fork of Nyaughty's ReAnimate. Animation Swap can make the start transition instant when an idle has no start of its own, and default-idle mods can be moved onto numbered /cpose slots. Everything else is ReAnimate as it is: turn your current pose into an idle pose with a single click.
